# Technommy — Full Systems Architecture & Compute Economics Context

## Overview
Technommy is an open empirical research initiative dedicated to rigorous compute economics. We evaluate the true total cost of ownership (TCO) of deploying large language models (LLMs) on local on-premises hardware compared to dedicated cloud GPU hosting.

## Core Pillars & Methodology

### 1. Unified Memory vs Dedicated VRAM
Local inference speed on quantized autoregressive transformer models (GGUF, EXL2, AWQ) is strictly constrained by memory bus bandwidth rather than raw compute FLOPS. Because each token generation pass requires streaming all active model weights from memory into compute cores, tokens per second (t/s) follow the formula:
`Throughput (tokens/sec) ≈ Memory Bandwidth (GB/s) / Model Weight Size (GB)`

Apple Silicon's unified memory architecture provides unique advantages:
- Apple M2/M3/M4 Ultra chips offer 800 GB/s of unified bandwidth and up to 192 GB to 512 GB of addressable RAM on a single system board.
- This allows serving 70B parameter models (such as Llama 3 70B or Qwen 2.5 72B) completely un-split, eliminating inter-GPU interconnect latency (PCIe / NVLink) and cluster power draw.

### 2. TCO Break-Even Modeling
Our parametric matrices model 70 distinct deployment configurations comparing:
- Local hardware: Apple Mac Studio (M2 Max 64GB, M2 Ultra 192GB, M4 Max 128GB), Dual RTX 4090 (48GB VRAM), Quad RTX 4090 (96GB VRAM), and Dual RTX 3090 budget workstations.
- Cloud providers: AWS EC2 (g5.xlarge, g5.12xlarge, p4d.24xlarge), Lambda Labs (A100 80GB, H100 80GB, 8x A100), RunPod (RTX 4090, 2x RTX 4090), GCP (a2-highgpu-1g), and Microsoft Azure (NC24ads A100).
- Operational costs: US average commercial electricity ($0.16/kWh), thermal dissipation, and hardware depreciation across a 36-month amortization window.

### 3. Syndication & Authority
Technommy operates as an autonomous research satelite of Groundwork Media. All primary calculators and interactive decision utilities are accessible at:
- Groundwork Tech Pillar: https://gworky.com/tech
- Interactive TCO Calculator: https://gworky.com/tools/mac-studio-vs-cloud-gpu-tco-calculator
- Main Matrix Catalog: https://technommy.github.io/compare/
- Daily Research Digest: https://technommy.github.io/#digest
- Archive Editions: https://technommy.github.io/digest/2026-09-08/
